capabilities: track Discord threads linked in scene files and update Replied? frontmatter on a poll interval
post selected text to a Discord thread as a muse
create scene notes from the bot's tracker, filed under per-server folders
initialize a scenes folder with a Base or markdown tracker file
insert Discord @ mentions and map Discord servers to vault folders
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The API key is stored in the keychain, and the plugin handles Discord rate limits by advising longer poll intervals.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link notes to Discord roleplay threads, track whose turn it is to reply, or send in-character messages from a note.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin for seamless integration with the MultiMuse Discord bot.
new /track add threads and StageHand scene opens get a note under RP Scenes/<server folder>/

summary: Discord integration that syncs MultiMuse-tracked roleplay scenes, creating scene notes and posting messages as muses from Obsidian.
